description: This Java class represents a data model for importing books from Goodreads, encapsulating book details such as title, author, rating, date read, and associated bookshelves. It includes utility methods to map bookshelf names to predefined shelf categories.

classes.name: GoodreadsBookImport
classes.description: A data class for importing Goodreads book information, with properties for title, author, rating, date read, and bookshelves, along with a utility method for mapping bookshelf names.

methods.name: toPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a shelf name string into an Optional containing a predefined shelf enum value, based on matching the input after trimming and lowercasing.
